title: Second-pass code review: no changes
body:
Per request, ran another review pass focused on areas not covered previously (scanner/agent/proxy/storage/cmdbuilder backends; non-Dashboard frontend pages; ml-service `main.py`).

### Result
No new high-confidence bugs found. Closing without code changes.

### Candidates investigated and dismissed

- **`backend/internal/agent/access_control.go:122`, `file_upload.go:340`** — alleged nil-deref on `resp2` when `err == nil`. Per `http.Client.Do` contract, `err == nil` ⇒ `resp != nil`. Not a bug.
- **`ml-service/app/main.py:105-106`** — alleged `IndexError` on `get_inputs()[0]`. Already inside `try/except` that sets `self.error` and falls back to heuristic mode.
- **`frontend/src/pages/Settings.jsx:181`** — already guarded by `Array.isArray(toolsData?.tools)`, which short-circuits on `null`.
- **`frontend/src/pages/Proxy.jsx:49`** — `res.json()` rejection is caught by the surrounding `try/catch` that surfaces via `setError`.
- **`frontend/src/pages/Findings.jsx:55-95`** — set-state-after-unmount is at most a benign React warning; not worth a structural change in isolation.
- **`backend/internal/proxy/proxy.go:174-178`** — async `SaveProxyRequest` already uses a bounded 5s timeout; intentional fire-and-forget.

### Known, out of scope for this pass
Architectural items previously surfaced and not addressed here:
- API key in EventSource query string (requires SSE auth contract change)
- Gemini API key in URL query string (provider auth shape)
- API key in `localStorage` (frontend auth model)
